title: Elara and the Golden Shell of the Sunken Castle
logline: A curious girl and her friendly dolphin friend embark on an underwater adventure to find a magical golden shell and awaken the wonders of a forgotten sunken castle.

character_bible.name: Elara
character_bible.visual_appearance: Small human girl, about 7 years old, with bright, curious emerald green eyes and long, wavy auburn hair tied with a sky-blue ribbon. She has a sprinkle of freckles on her nose.
character_bible.signature_clothing: A soft, seafoam green tunic dress with delicate seashell embroidery along the hem, worn over sunny yellow leggings.
character_bible.distinct_accessories: A small, woven straw satchel slung across her shoulder.

character_bible.name: Finny
character_bible.visual_appearance: A medium-sized, friendly dolphin with shimmering sapphire blue skin, a paler belly, and intelligent, sparkling black eyes.

scenes.title: The Whispering Waves
scenes.narrative_text: Elara loved exploring the sunny shores, dreaming of ancient tales. One afternoon, while collecting shiny pebbles, she found an old, worn map hinting at a mysterious Sunken Castle far beneath the waves. Her heart fluttered with excitement and wonder!

scenes.title: A Finny Friend Appears
scenes.narrative_text: The next day, Elara raced back to the water's edge. A shimmering splash caught her eye! A friendly dolphin, Finny, surfaced, his sparkling black eyes full of playful curiosity. Finny seemed to understand her map, nudging it gently with his nose, beckoning her towards the deeper, mysterious blue.

scenes.title: The Sunken Castle's Secret
scenes.narrative_text: With Finny's help, Elara, surrounded by a magical air bubble, dove deep into the ocean. There, nestled among glowing corals, stood the magnificent, ancient Sunken Castle! Its grand entrance held a pedestal, mysteriously empty, waiting for something special. It was clear: a Golden Shell was needed!

scenes.title: The Golden Shell's Glow
scenes.narrative_text: Finny nudged Elara towards a nearby cluster of glowing anemones. Hidden within, they found it: a magnificent Golden Shell, shimmering with inner light! Elara carefully placed the precious shell onto the castle's pedestal. Instantly, a warm, golden light flooded the Sunken Castle, revealing forgotten pathways and ancient murals!

scenes.title: A Sparkling Promise
scenes.narrative_text: With the Golden Shell's light, the Sunken Castle became a vibrant, living wonder! Elara and Finny shared a joyful moment, their adventure complete. As Elara returned to the surface, she carried a small, sparkling souvenir shell, a reminder of her brave journey and the amazing friendship she found with Finny, the friendly dolphin, in the heart of the Sunken Castle.
